description: Public-data native 1.0.0 minimal-dose probe: mix 990k current native v4 self-play labels with 10k Stockfish-labeled LC0 positions, then continue from v4 at very low LR. LC0 is ODbL public position data, not external net weights.

validation.promotion_gate: Compare against current native v4 first. Only run Berserk if this is positive against v4.
validation.ownership_definition: No external net weights. Training positions are 99% Enyo/native plus 1% LC0 ODbL public positions; labels are Stockfish scalar evals.
validation.reason: The LC0-only and 10% LC0 scalar fine-tunes lost to v4. This final scalar dose test checks whether LC0 can act as a tiny regularizer without overwriting native behavior.
